name: lk-mcp
description: Read and edit a LegendKeeper world wiki: pages, maps, timelines, calendars, templates and boards, with a spoiler guard for DM-only content.
long_description: lk-mcp lets Claude create, read, update and delete content in one LegendKeeper project through the LegendKeeper API. Every write supports a dry run, and versioned writes never overwrite a change made in the app since Claude's last read. An optional spoiler guard refuses any write that would show a protected term (one per line in a text file you keep outside the wiki) on content players can see; without a terms file Claude has full DM access.

api_key.title: LegendKeeper API key
api_key.description: An API key for the one project Claude should work in (LegendKeeper > Project settings > API). Try a sandbox project's key first.

guard_file.title: Spoiler terms file
guard_file.description: Optional. A text file with one protected term per line, kept outside the wiki. When set, a write that would show one of them to players is refused (secret blocks and hidden pages, documents and properties may hold them). Leave it empty for full DM access: every write is allowed.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Offer Claude only the read tools.
